mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals robust demand growth, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances despite sustained GDP growth, or GDP growth turns negative in the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and dampening equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 4.0% or returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward momentum in GDP growth (GDPC1) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) strengthens economic confidence, amplifying equity valuation growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 2% AND UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 does not rise >2% or UNRATE does not fall >0.1pp in the next 3 months, or 20d returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals weakening demand pressures, prompting investors to anticipate a slowdown and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not decline sufficiently or returns are negative despite the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 5.0% for two months signals labor market strength, boosting corporate profits and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not stay below 5.0% or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) alongside stronger GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust supply-demand balance, fostering business investment and equity appreciation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 1% AND INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 does not rise >1% or INDPRO does not rise >0.5% in the next 3 months, or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary contraction regime, a sustained increase in FEDFUNDS alongside falling GDP growth (GDPC1) signals tightening credit conditions, reducing corporate investment and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Proxies do not align with regime conditions (FEDFUNDS up AND GDPC1 down) or returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in labor demand (PAYEMS) reflects strong job market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth slows or returns are not positive.
